Jira Link: [DB-4281](https://yugabyte.atlassian.net/browse/DB-4281)
### Description

Packed columns toggle off and on testcase on master (2.17.1.0-b204) issue

FATALs seen is different than one seen in 2.16 (https://github.com/yugabyte/yugabyte-db/issues/15051 )

`F1116 11:50:54.526480 27612 operation_driver.cc:398] T 1add15f89bb5464cbf472dfd1fc65808 P 5ab9b2ded1d2457dbda84d0d8c19e7ed S RD-P Ts { physical: 1668599394522426 } kChangeMetadata (0x000055f41c7d50e0): Apply failed: Timed out (yb/util/operation_counter.cc:166): Timed out waiting for all pending operations to complete`

`java -jar /tmp/tests/artifacts/sample-app-tool/yb-sample-apps-1.8.23.jar --workload SqlDataLoadWithDDL --uuid 3c26ecdb-c0ab-465a-bb41-a066b425fdcb --create_table_name test_packed_columns_sql_efcce6 --num_writes -1 --num_threads_write 20 --num_reads -1 --num_threads_read 20 --num_unique_keys 10000000000 --num_value_columns 100 --batch_size 10 --num_indexes 2 --use_unique_index true --ddl_operations DELETE_ROW,UPDATE_ROW,DELETE_ROWS,UPDATE_ROWS,ADD_COLUMN,DROP_COLUMN --uuid_marker 90c42f17-a58c-45c6-869b-75c6c0fac226 --nodes 172.151.20.125:5433,172.151.20.237:5433,172.151.27.174:5433`

body:
Some further debugging. Fatal details: http://stress.dev.yugabyte.com/files/get?name=80ba832d-d554-4742-853f-56cb04abfc38-yb-tserver.FATAL.details.2022-11-16T18_11_46.pid4144.txt, seems to point to the intents -> regular apply path.
```
F20221116 18:11:46 ../../src/yb/tablet/tablet.cc:1406] T b253bb4c591c4b57b422d94bd359cb0f P cf99f07cac3a4b04b8fd4fb953cdf28a: Failed to write a batch with 0 operations into RocksDB: Corruption (yb/tablet/tablet_metadata.cc:269): Cannot find packing for table: 000033e6000030008000000000004000, schema version: 15
    @     0x56212ea06447  google::LogMessage::SendToLog()
    @     0x56212ea0738d  google::LogMessage::Flush()
    @     0x56212ea07899  google::LogMessageFatal::~LogMessageFatal()
    @     0x56212f5aa694  yb::tablet::Tablet::WriteToRocksDB()
    @     0x56212f5a68b7  yb::tablet::Tablet::ApplyIntents()
    @     0x56212f5a74f2  yb::tablet::Tablet::ApplyIntents()
    @     0x56212f656134  yb::tablet::TransactionParticipant::Impl::ProcessReplicated()
    @     0x56212f58d851  yb::tablet::UpdateTxnOperation::DoReplicated()
    @     0x56212f5820cf  yb::tablet::Operation::Replicated()
    @     0x56212f583d45  yb::tablet::OperationDriver::ReplicationFinished()
    @     0x56212ee0c91a  yb::consensus::ConsensusRound::NotifyReplicationFinished()
    @     0x56212ee5636b  yb::consensus::ReplicaState::ApplyPendingOperationsUnlocked()
    @     0x56212ee55819  yb::consensus::ReplicaState::AdvanceCommittedOpIdUnlocked()
    @     0x56212ee3dd0a  yb::consensus::RaftConsensus::UpdateReplica()
    @     0x56212ee22b07  yb::consensus::RaftConsensus::Update()
    @     0x56212f7e922c  yb::tserver::ConsensusServiceImpl::UpdateConsensus()
    @     0x56212ee92f82  std::__1::__function::__func<>::operator()()
    @     0x56212ee93a0f  yb::consensus::ConsensusServiceIf::Handle()
    @     0x56212f4ef42e  yb::rpc::ServicePoolImpl::Handle()
    @     0x56212f43553f  yb::rpc::InboundCall::InboundCallTask::Run()
    @     0x56212f4fdf93  yb::rpc::(anonymous namespace)::Worker::Execute()
    @     0x56212fb3114f  yb::Thread::SuperviseThread()
    @     0x7f8e1e8bc694  start_thread
    @     0x7f8e1edbe41d  __clone
```

The test was crash looping with this though, but the stack is not from the bootstrap path, so would this be the follower side apply, of an actual in flight RPC? Not sure I understand how this would fail on the RPC apply, but not on the bootstrap apply, after restart.

Separately, in an ERROR file: http://stress.dev.yugabyte.com/files/get?name=b48c5149-621e-4973-8fa6-a88d88cb5c5d-yb-tserver.ip-172-151-19-135.us-west-2.compute.internal.yugabyte.log.ERROR.20221116-181201.14078

```
E1116 18:12:27.252409 14547 db_impl.cc:3346] T b253bb4c591c4b57b422d94bd359cb0f P cf99f07cac3a4b04b8fd4fb953cdf28a [R]: Waiting after background compaction error: Corruption (yb/tablet/tablet_metadata.cc:269): Cannot find packing for table: 000033e6000030008000000000004000, schema version: 15, Accumulated background error counts: 1
E1116 18:12:27.252413 14781 db_impl.cc:3346] T b253bb4c591c4b57b422d94bd359cb0f P cf99f07cac3a4b04b8fd4fb953cdf28a [R]: Waiting after background compaction error: Corruption (yb/tablet/tablet_metadata.cc:269): Cannot find packing for table: 000033e6000030008000000000004000, schema version: 15, Accumulated background error counts: 2
F1116 18:12:27.568926 14752 tablet.cc:1406] T b253bb4c591c4b57b422d94bd359cb0f P cf99f07cac3a4b04b8fd4fb953cdf28a: Failed to write a batch with 0 operations into RocksDB: Corruption (yb/tablet/tablet_metadata.cc:269): Cannot find packing for table: 000033e6000030008000000000004000, schema version: 15
```
So the compaction also detected the schema packing missing independently, but all the FATAL stacks pointed to `RaftConsensus::Update`. Do we not FATAL if the compaction finds such an error?

Still saw this issue on **2.17.1.0-b357**

Hence reopening. 

`
F1222 09:55:06.115607 30960 tablet.cc:1426] T ed418c41e1854713b2cc2fe3ca8f01de P 4e5c01904f0b4182b2562c60c33f6ba5: Failed to write a batch with 0 operations into RocksDB: Corruption (yb/tablet/tablet_metadata.cc:283): Cannot find packing for table: 000033e6000030008000000000004000, schema version: 21
